mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a bathroom remodel in cities like Daly City or South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most bathroom remodels, especially those involving changes to plumbing, electrical, or structural elements, require permits in cities like Daly City, South San Francisco, and other Bay Area municipalities. Even moving a wall or changing a fixture's location often necessitates a permit to ensure safety and compliance with local building codes. It's crucial to consult with your general contractor or local building department before starting any work to understand specific permit requirements.
